driver.glossary: Calculated from the calendar day you were born (1 to 31 reduced to 1 to 9); reflects everyday personal style.

conductor.glossary: Calculated from your full date of birth (day + month + year reduced); reflects long-term direction.

calling_name.glossary: Calculated from the letters of the name you use day to day using the Chaldean letter-value table.

kua.glossary: Traditional directional group number derived from birth year and gender, used for desk and room orientation.

loshu_grid.glossary: Traditional 3x3 square arranging the digits 1 to 9 from your birth date into three rows, three columns, and two diagonals.

missing_numbers.glossary: Digits from 1 to 9 that do not appear in your birth date and indicate areas for everyday habit balance.

brahmasthan.glossary: Position 5 at the middle of the 3x3 square, linked with steadiness and practical balance.

rahu.glossary: Traditional lunar node linked with number 4, associated with structure, systems, and unconventional thinking.

ketu.glossary: Traditional lunar node linked with number 7, associated with reflection, study, and careful analysis.

guru.glossary: Planet linked with number 3, associated with learning, teaching, and steady growth.

shukra.glossary: Planet linked with number 6, associated with home harmony, care, and design appreciation.

budh.glossary: Planet linked with number 5, associated with clear communication, adaptability, and practical coordination.

vastu.glossary: Traditional principles for arranging workspace and home orientation cleanly and practically.

golden_raj_yoga.intl_secondary: traditional name for the 4-5-6 diagonal pattern
golden_raj_yoga.glossary: Traditional name for having all three digits 4, 5, and 6 present along the primary diagonal of the Lo Shu Square.

silver_raj_yoga.intl_secondary: traditional name for the 2-5-8 diagonal pattern
silver_raj_yoga.glossary: Traditional name for having all three digits 2, 5, and 8 present along the secondary Earth diagonal of the Lo Shu Square.

personal_year.glossary: Annual 1-to-9 cycle derived from your birth day, birth month, and the calendar year.
